= Roleplay Commands Guide =

Basic roleplaying commands: skill checks, dice, languages, pose/say/emit, hustle, factions, and improvement points.

----

== Skill Checks ==

<pre>
roll &lt;attribute&gt; + &lt;skill&gt; [&lt;+/- modifier&gt;]
roll &lt;attribute&gt; + &lt;skill&gt; [&lt;+/- modifier&gt;] vs &lt;DV or difficulty name&gt;
roll/luck &lt;amount&gt;=&lt;attribute&gt; + &lt;skill&gt; [&lt;+/- modifier&gt;] [vs &lt;DV&gt;]
</pre>

'''Examples:'''
* <code>roll Reflexes + Handgun</code> – Roll only (no success/fail)
* <code>roll Intelligence + Interface +1 vs 13</code> – Roll vs DV 13
* <code>roll Reflexes + Shoulder Arms -3 vs Legendary</code> – Roll vs Legendary (DV 29)
* <code>roll/luck 3=intelligence + interface + 2 vs 20</code> – Spend 3 Luck (+1 per point) before rolling

'''Mechanics:''' 1d10 + attribute + skill + modifier. Critical success (natural 10): add another d10. Critical failure (natural 1): subtract another d10.

'''Difficulty names:''' Simple (9), Everyday (13), Difficult (15), Professional (17), Heroic (21), Incredible (24), Legendary (29)

'''Luck:''' Spend Luck points before rolling; each point adds +1 to the roll. Luck pool refills at the start of the next session.

'''Aliases:''' <code>check</code>

----

== Dice Rolling ==

<pre>
dice [NdX] [+/- modifier] [vs N or difficulty name]
</pre>

'''Examples:'''
* <code>dice 3d10</code>
* <code>dice 2d6 + 2 vs 13</code>
* <code>dice 1d20 vs Difficult</code>

'''Supported dice:''' d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20, d100

'''Aliases:''' <code>d</code>

'''Note:''' For skill checks, use <code>roll</code> instead of <code>dice</code>.

----

== Languages ==

<pre>
language [&lt;language_name&gt;]   - Set or view speaking language
language list                 - List your known languages
language all                  - List all available languages
language none                 - Clear speaking language
</pre>

'''Examples:'''
* <code>language Spanish</code> – Set Spanish as your speaking language
* <code>language</code> – Show current language

'''Language tagging in speech:''' Use <code>~</code> to mark text as being in your set language. Those who know the language see the actual text; others see it masked. Examples: <code>say ~Hola, amigo!</code> or <code>pose waves and says "~Bonjour!"</code> – Set language with <code>language Spanish</code> first.

'''Aliases:''' <code>lang</code>, <code>+language</code>, <code>+lang</code>, <code>+languages</code>

----

== Pose, Say, and Emit ==

<pre>
pose &lt;text&gt;     or  : &lt;text&gt;     - Pose action to room (third person)
say &lt;message&gt;    or  " &lt;message&gt;  - Speak to room
@emit &lt;message&gt;  or  \\ &lt;message&gt;  - Emit without name (narrator style)
</pre>

'''Examples:'''
* <code>pose nods and checks his weapon.</code>
* <code>: waves at the group.</code>
* <code>say Hello, choombas!</code>
* <code>"Watch your back.</code>
* <code>@emit A distant explosion echoes through the street.</code>

'''Pose breaks:''' In non-OOC rooms, a pose break (your name) is sent before pose/say/emit so others know who is acting.

'''Language tagging:''' Use <code>~</code> for speech in your set language: <code>say ~Bonjour!</code> or <code>pose waves and says "~Hola!"</code>

'''Reality layers:''' (If used) Messages are filtered by umbra, material, or dreaming so only characters in the same layer see them.

----

== Hustle System ==

<pre>
hustle   - Open hustle menu (weekly side job)
</pre>

'''How it works:'''
* Spend a full seven days working a side job
* Roll 1d6 to determine outcome
* Payout depends on your '''Role''', '''Role Ability Rank''', and the roll
* Tier by Role Ability Rank: 1–4, 5–7, 8–10 (higher ranks = better pay)
* '''One attempt per week''' (7 days)

'''Requirements:'''
* Character must be '''approved''' by staff
* Character must have a role with a hustle table

'''Staff commands:'''
* <code>clearhustle &lt;character&gt;</code> – [Admin] Clear hustle attempt (allow re-roll)
* <code>resethustles</code> – [Admin] Reset all hustle attempts
* <code>debughustle &lt;character&gt;</code> – [Admin] Debug hustle status

----

== Factions ==

Factions are staff-managed world entities (corps, gangs, organizations). Players can view factions, check reputation, and request to join.

=== Player Commands ===

<pre>
faction                    - List factions
faction &lt;n&gt;               - Faction info (by number or name)
faction/info &lt;n&gt;          - Faction details
faction/list              - List factions
faction/rep &lt;n&gt;           - Your reputation with faction
faction/influence         - Influence of all factions
faction/join &lt;faction&gt;    - Request to join (creates job)
</pre>

=== Faction Join Workflow ===

# Player: <code>faction/join &lt;faction name&gt;</code>
# System creates a '''Job''' in the FACTION queue
# Job is assigned to the faction's '''staff sponsor'''
# Staff sponsor (and optionally faction head) receives mail
# Staff: <code>faction/add &lt;faction&gt;=&lt;character&gt;</code> to approve
# Player is added to the faction

'''Requirements:''' Faction must have a staff sponsor. Faction head is optional but can be notified.

=== Staff Commands ===

<pre>
faction/add &lt;faction&gt;=&lt;character&gt;      - Add member
faction/remove &lt;faction&gt;=&lt;character&gt;   - Remove member
faction/head &lt;faction&gt;=&lt;character&gt;     - Set faction head
faction/sponsor &lt;faction&gt;=&lt;staff&gt;      - Set staff sponsor
faction/modify &lt;character&gt;/&lt;faction&gt;=&lt;amount&gt;  - Modify reputation
faction/missionposter &lt;faction&gt;=add|remove|list [character]  - Designate mission posters
</pre>

=== Admin Commands ===

<pre>
faction/create &lt;n&gt;              - Create faction
faction/create/type &lt;n&gt;=&lt;type&gt;  - Create with type
faction/type &lt;n&gt;=&lt;type&gt;         - Change type
faction/desc &lt;n&gt;=&lt;description&gt; - Set description
faction/init                    - Initialize default factions
</pre>

=== Groups (Player-Created) ===

'''Groups''' are player-created crews/teams, separate from staff-managed factions.

<pre>
group create &lt;name&gt;       - Create a group
group/join &lt;name&gt;          - Request to join
group/approve &lt;group&gt; &lt;character&gt;  - [Leader] Approve join request
group/leave                - Leave your group
</pre>

----

== Improvement Points (IP) ==

IP are earned through play and spent to raise skills, attributes, and role abilities.

=== Viewing IP ===

<pre>
+ip              - Your IP status
+ip &lt;name&gt;       - [Staff] View another player's IP
+ip/log          - Your IP history
+ip/log &lt;name&gt;   - [Staff] Another player's IP log
</pre>

=== Spending IP ===

<pre>
+ip/buy &lt;stat&gt;   - Spend IP to raise skill, attribute, or role ability
+ip/refund       - Refund your last purchase
</pre>

'''Examples:'''
* <code>+ip/buy handgun</code> – Raise Handgun skill
* <code>+ip/buy athletics</code> – Raise Athletics
* <code>+ip/buy reflexes</code> – Raise Reflexes (attribute)
* <code>+ip/buy combat_awareness</code> – Raise Role Ability

=== IP Costs (Cyberpunk RED) ===

{| class="wikitable" border="1"
|-
! Type !! Cost per level/rank
|-
| Typical skills || 20 IP per level (1→2 = 40, 2→3 = 60, etc.)
|-
| Difficult skills (×2) || 40 IP per level (Autofire, Martial Arts, Pilot Air, Heavy Weapons, Demolitions, Electronics, Paramedic)
|-
| Role abilities || 60 IP per rank
|-
| Attributes || 20 IP per point
|}

=== Staff Commands ===

<pre>
+ip/award &lt;name&gt;=&lt;amount&gt;   - Award IP to a player
+ip/remove &lt;name&gt;=&lt;amount&gt;   - Remove IP from a player
</pre>

=== Earning IP ===

Approved characters receive '''weekly IP''' automatically (via the IP weekly script). Staff can also award IP for good roleplay, mission completion, or other contributions.

'''Aliases:''' <code>ip</code>
